runs.text: . This notation records the chain-rule factor.
For definite integrals, either change the bounds immediately or substitute back before evaluating; do not mix x-bounds with a u-integrand.

items.text: The displayed definite formula assumes the usual continuity and differentiability conditions that make the change of variables valid.
A missing constant factor may be supplied algebraically; a genuinely missing variable factor may require another method.
A non-one-to-one substitution can still work in one dimension under suitable hypotheses, but signs and interval splitting require care.
Do not leave both u and x in the transformed integrand.
When solving for dx, carry every factor and sign.
